lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in a roughly grid-like pattern with higher density observed in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot alignments, forming a series of rectangular grid nodes across the visible mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light upper edges to shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, high-luminance teleost fish (likely remoras) swimming in close proximity to the lower lateral and ventral regions.
